artworks.title: Slave Trade
artworks.artist: John Raphael Smith after George Morland
artworks.description: This print shows individuals being forced into a small boat. A group is gathered to the left of center, with a dog nearby, and distant people on horseback move away under a landscape of palm trees and a clouded sky. In the center, two men with light skin restrain a man with dark skin, with one raising a whip or wooden switch. A woman and child with dark skin look on in distress as a man with light skin stands next to them and gestures off to the right. Near the bottom-right corner, a small rowboat is on the shore with two people sitting in it. One of the people in the boat appears to have dark skin and is hiding their face in their hands. In the background, a large ship is anchored by the coast on the left.

artworks.title: Lear and Cordelia
artworks.artist: John Raphael Smith after Henry Fuseli
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies of two individuals, a woman and an older man, in an embrace. The woman is kneeling with her arm around the man's shoulders. She has delicately arched eyebrows and closed eyes, curly hair pulled back, and wears a flowing gown. The man has a heavily bearded face with thick hair, and is dressed in traditional attire. A goblet or chalice is on a small table beside them. The background features heavy drapery.

artworks.title: Clara
artworks.description: The image features a woman from the waist up. She is depicted leaning forward slightly with one hand raising a thin fabric over her head. Her facial features are softly detailed with a gentle smile, narrow, arched eyebrows, and large expressive eyes. Her curly hair frames her face. The woman is wearing elaborate clothing with layered ruffles on the neckline of her dress and a flowing garment covering her shoulders. The fabric appears luxurious. She is not wearing visible jewelry and is not holding any objects besides the fabric over her head. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Les Deux Ami (The Two Friends)
artworks.medium: mezzotint and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two women from the waist up, sitting closely together and facing the viewer. The woman on the left has a serene expression and delicate facial features. Her long hair is styled into elaborate curls under a large hat with gathered fabric. The woman on the right also has delicate facial features, with styled curly hair partially covered by a large bonnet made of sheer fabric. Both women wear finely detailed clothing with ruffles and lace. They are seated within an oval frame, and the background is textured.

artworks.title: The Duchess of Grafton
artworks.artist: Jan Verkolje I after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a portrait from the knees up, seated elegantly. She is turned slightly to her left, with her left arm on her lap and her right arm on a nearby surface. She has a calm expression, delicate facial features, and curled hair with soft waves falling on her shoulders. She wears an elegant dress with draped fabric, intricate embroidery, and some exposed shoulders and chest. The background includes architectural columns, foliage, a large vase of flowers, and dark drapery framing the scene.

artworks.title: Madam Parson
artworks.artist: Jan Verkolje I after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The woman depicted in the artwork is shown from the knees up, seated with her body slightly turned to the left. Her head is turned toward the viewer, with a direct gaze. She has curly, voluminous hair framing her face, with softly rendered facial features. She is dressed in a lavish dress with a low neckline, decorated with buttons along the front, and puffed sleeves gathering at her shoulders. The dress appears to be made of a luxurious fabric, with folds and drapes. She rests her right hand in her lap, while her left arm is positioned on the armrest beside her. On both wrists, she wears a pearl bracelet. The background features a drapery cascading from above, with a window or opening showing a garden landscape to the right. The garden includes trees and a distant view of a fountain surrounded by shrubbery.

artworks.title: Children Bathing (The Hoppner Children)
artworks.description: The image features three children. One child is standing, facing slightly to the side with one arm bent and the hand resting on the chest. This child has shoulder-length light hair with waves and is wearing a long-sleeved outfit with a large white collar and dark shoes with straps. The other two children are seated on the ground near a small stream. The child in the middle is wrapped in a light-colored cloth. The third child is seated, facing the middle child, with similar hair length and texture, mostly unclothed and turned towards the viewer. The background shows large trees and a partly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Lord Cornwallis
artworks.artist: William Ward after Sir William Beechey
artworks.description: The image shows a middle-aged man standing in a regal pose. He has white, wavy hair styled in an 18th-century fashion and wears elaborate period clothing with detailed embroidery. The man holds a plumed hat in his right hand and rests his left hand on a decorative table. The background features classical architecture, columns, a cloudy sky, and decorative feathers on the table.

artworks.title: The Blind Beggar of Bednall Green
artworks.description: The image shows a young woman standing behind an older man who is seated. The young woman has an oval-shaped face, dark hair partially covered by a wide-brimmed hat, and wears a dress with long sleeves. The older man has a bushy beard and white hair, wearing a cloak and holding a fabric or blanket. The background includes a cloudy sky, foliage, and a stone structure on the left.

artworks.title: Princess Caroline Matilda, Queen of Denmark
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman's upper body and head in a slight three-quarter view. She is looking to the side with a serene expression, featuring soft facial features, a gentle gaze, and full lips. Her hair is styled in an elegant updo with decorative adornments. She is wearing rich and detailed attire, including a low-cut, lace-trimmed neckline with a bejeweled bodice and draped fabric with a textured sheen. She also wears a multi-strand pearl necklace and teardrop-shaped pearl earrings. The background is a plain, dark surface.

artworks.title: Jemima Countess Cornwallis
artworks.artist: James Watson after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 37.5 x 28 cm (14 3/4 x 11 in.)
artworks.description: This image depicts a woman in profile sitting with her body facing slightly to the right. The woman is shown from the waist up, displaying a serene and composed posture. Her head is slightly turned, showing a side profile view of her facial features, including high cheekbones and a gentle expression. Her hair is styled in an elegant updo, adding to her sophisticated appearance. She is wearing a flowing dress with long sleeves, decorated with a sash around her waist and a brooch or ornament at the neckline. She holds an open book in her right hand, resting against her leg. The background includes a dark, textured wall or curtain and an outdoor scene with trees, foliage, and distant hills under a cloudy sky, giving a sense of tranquility and introspection to the portrait.

artworks.title: Jemima Countess Cornwallis
artworks.artist: James Watson after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman in a side profile position. She has delicate features, a prominent nose, and a serene expression. Her hair is styled in an updo, and she wears a high-necked dress with long sleeves and a belt. Her hands rest in her lap, with one hand holding a small book or paper. The background features trees, detailed leaves, and distant hills or mountains in soft, warm tones.

artworks.title: The Female Correspondent
artworks.description: The image displays two women in a room. One woman is seated at a table, facing slightly right, wearing a dress with fur cuffs and collar. She is extinguishing a candle on the table, which is covered with a cloth and has inkwells and papers. The other woman stands holding a bucket, facing the seated woman. The background shows heavy drapery, and underneath the table, a small dog is resting.

artworks.title: The Deshabille
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 33 x 22.9 cm (13 x 9 in.)
sheet: 34 x 26.1 cm (13 3/8 x 10 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated sideways, looking into a mirror she is holding. Her body, from head to knees, is visible as she sits on a chair. Her head is slightly bowed, and her hand is near her face. She has delicate facial features with a slight double chin and soft cheeks. She wears a white cap and a flowing gown with long sleeves. The chair has carved upright posts, heavy curtains are partially visible behind her. The background is simple and softly lit, casting gentle shadows on her and the mirror frame.

artworks.title: Midsummer Night's Dream
artworks.artist: Samuel Cousins after Sir Edwin Landseer

artworks.title: The Scapegoat
artworks.artist: Charles Mottram after William Holman Hunt
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and mezzotint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a goat at eye-level, with a horizon at the upper third showing water meeting mountains in the distance. The goat is detailed, surrounded by rocky ground and skeletal remains. The color palette is gray, with mountains, clouds, and a large moon giving depth to the landscape.

artworks.title: Butte aux Cailles
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a wooden structure resembling a windmill or similar building with a tall, tapering tower in the middle distance. The horizon lies at the top of the composition where the structure merges with the sky. Additional rooftops and trees can be seen on the horizon. In the foreground, there are several figures dispersed across a grassy area, depicted with loose, impressionistic brushstrokes. The brushwork appears fluid and delicate with soft textures. The color palette consists of light greens, earthy browns, and pale blues, blending together to create a tranquil atmosphere. The sky above is depicted with pale washes of light blue melting into a nearly white expanse.

artworks.title: Charles Baudelaire
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 23.1 x 18.1 cm (9 1/8 x 7 1/8 in.)
mount: 34 x 25.4 cm (13 3/8 x 10 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body and part of the shoulders of a man in a seated or standing pose. His expression is serious, and he is facing forward. His facial features include a long, straight nose, deep-set eyes, and thin, pursed lips. He has short hair, thinning at the crown. The man is wearing a dark, high-collared coat with a large bow tie over a white shirt. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain and softly blurred, emphasizing the man's face and attire.

artworks.title: Mädchen im Korsett (Girl in a Corset)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated from the waist up, with their head tilted back, eyes closed. The facial features include a prominent chin and slightly parted lips, with wavy short hair. They wear a corset and a dark, vertically striped garment covering their legs. Holding two fans, the background is textured with dark shading on one side.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. It shows soldiers and onlookers, a figure on a cross with a sign above inscribed with the letters "INRI." Several figures are gathered around the base of the cross, with different expressions and gestures. Some hold spears while others seem to be conversing or pointing towards the figure on the cross. The background features linework indicating a landscape with trees and distant hills, creating depth and setting. The style resembles early engravings or woodcuts, characterized by heavy use of lines and detailed textures to convey form and shadow.

artworks.title: La Maison Enchantée (The Haunted House)
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate building with a prominent facade in the center. The scene includes the building, natural surroundings, intricate architectural details, latticed windows, turrets, chimneys, and grazing livestock. A woman is tending to the animals by a gate. The brushstrokes create a textured quality in the foliage and sky. The color palette is sepia-toned, providing a nostalgic and timeless feel, with dark shading contrasting the lighter tones of the building.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Woman at a Well
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with architectural elements and natural scenery. There is a rustic building with a large arched entrance, figures near its base, various structures, trees, pointed rooftops, and a dome-like structure in the distance. The sky is filled with horizontal lines. The etching style features fine lines with cross-hatching for shadows and texture. The palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Magot de la Chine
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a seated figure with a large, rounded belly, smiling broadly with eyes closed. The figure is seated cross-legged with both arms resting on the knees, one hand holding an object. The sculpture is monochromatic in shades of gray with textured drapery. It appears substantial and solid, commanding attention.

artworks.title: A Man Gazing across a Still Pond
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a person standing near water, a figure with a staff surrounded by grass and rocks, looking towards the landscape. The horizon with hills and sparse foliage is low in the image. The brushstrokes create texture and depth with detailed etching lines. The color palette is monochrome using different shades of ink. Trees and hills recede in the distance, with birds flying in the sky.
